meta.name: brief
meta.description: /cs:brief <topic> — Generate a one-page strategy brief from an office-hours intake. First step in the strategic sprint pipeline. Use when a strategic question needs to be framed before boardroom deliberation — e.g. locking options, assumptions, and success criteria for a pricing change or a market-entry decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把战略问题转化为一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在高层讨论前快速框定战略选项与成功标准
copy.tagline_en: Turn strategic questions into a one-page brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to frame strategic options and success criteria before boardroom deliberation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将一个话题或会议记录整理成一页战略简报，包含背景、问题、选项、假设、约束、成功标准和终止标准，并保存为文件。
howto.when: 当你需要为董事会讨论框定战略问题（如定价变更或市场进入决策）时，使用命令 /cs:brief <话题> 触发。

say.text: 用 /cs:brief 帮我写一份关于进入东南亚市场的战略简报。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份包含选项和成功标准的简报。

say.text: 根据上次的办公时间会议记录，生成一份战略简报。
say.note: Claude 会解析会议记录并输出简报。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn a topic or office-hours output into a one-page strategy brief with context, question, options, assumptions, constraints, success criteria, and kill criteria, saved as a file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to frame a strategic question for boardroom deliberation (e.g., pricing change or market-entry decision) by using the command /cs:brief <topic>.

say_en.text: Use /cs:brief to create a strategy brief for entering the Southeast Asian market.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a brief with options and success criteria.

say_en.text: Generate a strategy brief from the last office-hours meeting notes.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the notes and output the brief.
